case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For many years, our foundry has stood for tradition and reliable quality, and we deeply value the connection between our businesses. We welcome the proposal for a 24-month contract term, which strengthens our long-standing partnership and provides mutual planning security. However, delaying the effective date to April 2027 is not feasible for us due to the wage increases we are already bearing. 

We are prepared to reduce our price to a price of €51.80 per unit, provided we can compromise on an effective date of January 2027. This main Angebot includes Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.40 per unit, which comes with a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Our proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate your willingness to move closer to a mutual agreement. 

For generations, our foundry has taken immense pride in delivering high-quality castings to valued partners like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.90 per unit while accepting the April 2027 start date. 

Our offer stands at a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We believe this proposal reflects both our commitment to your success and the traditional values of craftsmanship we uphold here in the region.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
